title: Synthesis, characterization, and hydrogen storage capacities of hierarchical porous carbide derived carbon monolith
material_description: HPCDCM | hierarchical porous carbide-derived carbon monolith: ordered mesoporous SiC monolith (OMSCM; polycarbosilane PCS-800 nanocast in KIT-6 silica, pressed with 10 wt% P123 binder, pyrolysed at 1000 °C in Ar, silica etched with 40% HF) chlorinated with Cl2 at 800 °C for 40 min; tablet 8.1 mm diameter x 2.5 mm thick; bimodal micropores (~0.9 nm) and mesopores (3.1 nm)
source_location: main-6 (p. 23898), Fig. 8a, magenta circles (HPCDCM, -196 °C, 0-1 bar), marker 1 of 11
notes: archive: fig8a_HPCDCM_77K_ambient.json. Digitized 2.157 mg/g at 0.024 bar (axis in mg/g); uptake_wt_pct = W1 = 0.1 x mg/g.
